always.line: May God bless and keep you always
stanza: May God bless and keep you always
May your wishes all come true
May you always do for others
And let others do for you
May you build a ladder to the stars
And climb on every rung
As I write this letter
Send my love to you
Remember that I'll always
Be in love with you
Mrs. Lovett
What a charming notion
Eminently practical
And yet appropriate as always
I'll be loving you always
With a love that's true always
When the things you've planned
Need a helping hand
I will understand always, always

always.line: Until the rainbow burns the stars out in the sky (Always)
stanza: Until the rainbow burns the stars out in the sky (Always)
Until the ocean covers every mountain high (Always)
Until the dolphin flies and parrots live at sea (Always)
Until we dream of life and life becomes a dream
All the while, I'll await my armored fate with a smile
Still wanna try, still believe in
Good days, good days, always
Always inside (Always in my mind, always in my mind, mind)
Good day living in my mind

always.line: You were on the other side, like always
stanza: I was on a heavy tip
Trying to cross a canyon with a broken limb
You were on the other side, like always
Wondering what to do with life

always.line: But you'll have this place to call home, always
stanza: Wishing you godspeed, glory
There will be mountains you won't move
Still, I'll always be there for you
How I do
I let go of my claim on you
It's a free world
You'll look down on where you came from sometimes
But you'll have this place to call home, always
